status: Blockout (pass 1): silhouette, sections, mass, slots and engines. No detail, damage or textures.

source.sprite_choice: The .ship renders thunder2.png; the up-res master (and the mod runtime texture graphics/battle/aircraft/thunder.png) was generated from and registered to thunder.png, so SPRITE is thunder.png. The two share the body aft of X 7 but differ forward: thunder.png has an asymmetric twin-prong port pod and a long lance offset to starboard (Y -1..-4); thunder2.png has two symmetric gun booms at the slots and no lance. The master keeps thunder.png's full-length lance but centres it and draws thunder2-style booms at +-5.5. The model follows the master, so it reads as a hybrid of the two sprites; IoU is reported against both.

units: One sprite pixel per unit about the .ship centre; multiply by metres_per_unit for metres

scale.summary: Heavy interceptor, one pilot, lance nose, twin gun booms, two engine pods
scale.method: Sized from the single-seat cockpit: the canopy is 7.2 x 2.6 units, which at 0.45 m/unit is a 3.2 m by 1.2 m bubble, inside the 2.6-3.5 m by 0.9-1.3 m of real single-seat canopies, and the seated 1.8 m proxy clears it. Width bounds the range (0.9-1.3 m sill -> 0.35-0.50), canopy length the low end (>= 2.6 m -> 0.37), overall length the high end (41 units <= 22 m -> 0.53).

sprite.pixel_to_model: col c, row r (from top) covers X 29-r..30-r, Y 12-c..13-c

root.name: Thunder root
root.note: the .ship centre: the game's rotation pivot

anchor_convention: ARROWS empties; local +X points along the slot angle (0 = nose, 180 = aft)
notes: Integer slots straddle the sprite centre line: model symmetric about Y = 0; gun booms and muzzles at +-5.5 (slot mean), pods and engine bells at +-6.5 (engine slot mean). Anchors keep the exact .ship XY.
All three slots are HIDDEN: the ion cannon (port) and light dual MG (starboard) are the boom barrels the sprite draws; the swarmer launcher is the dark bay on the spine at WS 003, no visible gun.
Forward of X 14 the model follows the master (centred lance, symmetric booms), which matches neither vanilla sprite exactly; see source.sprite_choice.

silhouette.method: top render alpha vs sprite alpha (>127), nearest-sampled into the top camera frame at 37.09 px per unit
